description.value: A large, community-based, cross-sectional study examined structural brain differences associated with occasional and frequent cannabis use in adolescents and young adults using high-resolution T1-weighted MRI.

spans.text: In the current study, we leverage a large sample of adolescents and young adults ascertained in the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort [PNC; 31 ] to examine structural brain differences related to levels of cannabis use.

description.value: The study was a single-site, community-based, cross-sectional observational study of adolescents and young adults from the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort.
